propositions: A class with an unreachable primary model should fall back to configured alternatives via FallbackModel wrapper, not fail outright
Fallback entries are inline model configs with provider/endpoint/model shape, not named preset references

The fallback_on condition must discriminate between errors where switching providers helps (rate limits, timeouts, provider unavailability) and those where it does not (auth, quota exhaustion, oversized input)
Capabilities are computed as the conservative intersection over primary and all fallback candidates before the FallbackModel wrapper is built
Attestation (provider_provenance and ran_model) must record which candidate actually answered, not the primary, to prevent misattribution when a fallback fires
The FallbackModel must be entered as an async context manager so pydantic-ai's sub-provider clients are properly initialized and closed
